title: Correct monthly total volume calculations and add monthly aggregate summary

requirements.summary: Correct per-habit monthly total volume calculations for numeric workout volumes, reps, and time (seconds-accurate when timeString exists) for the selected month.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a habit with unitType = "reps" and a per-completion volume of 10, and 3 completed days in the selected month, the UI shows a monthly total of 30 for that habit.

Given a habit with a numeric per-completion volume (e.g., workouts volume already expressed as weight×reps×sets per completion) and 4 completed days, the UI shows monthly total = per-completion volume × 4 for that habit.
Given a time-based habit with per-completion value stored as timeString "1:15" and 2 completed days, the UI shows monthly total "2:30" (seconds-accurate).
Given a time-based habit without timeString but with minutes stored, the UI still computes a correct monthly total and formats it as M:SS.
Monthly totals are correct immediately after toggling completion checkboxes (i.e., after React Query updates and re-render).

file_operations.description: Update getMonthlyTotalVolume() to remove the habit-name special casing and consistently compute monthly totals as (per-completion value × completed-days count) for reps, time, and numeric workout-style units. For time, compute per-completion in seconds when timeString is available (fallback to minutes×60 when not), multiply seconds by completed-days count, then format back to M:SS. For non-time, non-reps units, treat entry.minutes as the per-completion numeric volume and multiply by completed-days count (returning "0" when missing). Ensure the function relies only on the habit’s completionMap so optimistic React Query checkbox toggles immediately reflect updated totals.

Ensure the per-habit "Monthly total" display continues to use the corrected getMonthlyTotalVolume() output for all habits in the selected month, so totals visibly update immediately after completion checkbox toggles.

requirements.summary: Add a selected-month aggregate summary that totals monthly volumes across all habits by category (reps, time, workout-style numeric).
acceptanceCriteria: When multiple reps habits exist, the aggregate reps total equals the sum of each reps habit’s monthly total for the selected month.
When multiple time habits exist, the aggregate time total equals the sum of each time habit’s monthly total for the selected month, computed seconds-accurately when timeString is available.
If no habits exist for a category (e.g., no time habits), the aggregate summary displays 0 (or 0:00 for time) for that category.
Changing the selected month updates the aggregate totals to reflect the newly selected month.

file_operations.description: Create a small summary component rendered for the selected month that iterates over the provided habits and computes: (1) total reps (sum of each reps habit’s monthly total as a number), (2) total time (sum of time totals in seconds then format as M:SS), and (3) total workout-style numeric volume (sum of non-time, non-reps numeric monthly totals). Display English labels and show 0 / 0:00 when categories are empty.

Add or export reusable helpers needed by the aggregate summary to avoid duplicating logic (e.g., a helper that returns per-habit monthly totals in a raw numeric form: reps/workout as number, time as seconds), ensuring the aggregate summary matches the corrected per-habit computations from REQ-1.

Wire the new MonthlyVolumeSummary component into the existing view (within the existing BecomingView layout near the MonthTabs/grid) and pass it the currently fetched habits plus selectedMonth so changing months or toggling completion immediately updates the aggregate totals.
